evidence: C1/C5 sit adjacent to U1's 3V3/EN pins but overlap each other at the board edge, and C2 (+3V3/GND) is stranded mid-board roughly 10mm below U1, far from any IC power pin.

R3/R4 float in open space far from both J1 (bottom-right) and U1 (top-left), so the USB chain stretches diagonally across the whole board with long ratsnest spans instead of reading as an ordered local chain.
Straight pad-to-pad ratsnest lines from U1's TXD/RXD pins to J2 and from R3/R4 to J1 visibly cross each other in the board center, forcing avoidable crossover traces.
The ESP32 antenna keepout sits at the top board edge (sub-mm margin) and is free of components and visible copper in both the 2D and 3D top views.
VBUS enters at J1 in the bottom-right corner with no visible protection, filter, regulator, or bulk capacitor near it, and the only power-rail cap C2 is stranded mid-board on the opposite diagonal.
